title: Great data, but needs better
body:
Apple Health does a great job of collecting and displaying health data, especially with Apple Watch. My biggest issue is that it doesn’t do enough to explain what the data actually means for me.

I would love more personalised insights that identify what is going well, what needs attention, why it matters, and what practical steps I could take to improve.

Instead of only showing that a metric has increased or decreased, tell me: Is this meaningful? Should I be concerned? What can I do about it?

Apple collects so much valuable health data. Helping users turn that data into actionable information would make the Health app significantly more useful.
